BETA Close X Ninety One PLC has announced the repurchase of 1,257,600 of its ordinary shares between June 29, 2026, and July 3, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The purchases were executed at prices ranging from 205.80 GBp to 216.60 GBp per share, with a volume-weighted average price of 210.72 GBp. The company intends to cancel these repurchased shares, and following these transactions, Ninety One PLC has no shares held in treasury, with 664,296,147 ordinary shares currently in issue.
